title: Tech Saturn Tsuushin: Autumn 1995: Special CD-ROM
native_title: ＴＥＣＨ サターン通信 ＡＵＴＵＭＮ １９９５ Ｓｐｅｃｉａｌ ＣＤ‐ＲＯＭ
overview: The special CD-ROM packaged with the Autumn 1995 issue (Vol. 2) of ASCII's TECH Saturn Tsuushin magazine. It carries demo versions of Saturn games for readers to try, including a playable demo of Fire Pro Gaiden: Blazing Tornado.
